div.div: جَنَدِلٌ , (S in art. جدل,) or جُنَدِلٌ, (Kr, K,) A place in which are stones (Kr, S, K) collected together: (Kr, K:) but ISd doubts its correctness. (TA.) And أَرْضٌ جُنَدِلَةٌ, (K,) and sometimes with fet-h, (Sgh, K,) i. e., to the ج, [جَنَدِلَةٌ,] (TK,) A land abounding with stones. (Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
